findings.rationale: Capture utility-dialog opener before hiding Settings; restore usable opener or toggle on close. Specialized pack/detail handling retained.
Capture queue initiating control before blur; restore connected control or matching stable ID/list after cancellation. Guard deferred focus and scroll by owner generation.
Settings Escape explicitly restores its toggle.

Synchronous enabled Close handoff before hiding/disabling focused publish/export controls. Completion never restores a stale initiating control; synchronous preview replacement preserves the user’s current control. Separate publish/PNG browser checks; original audit final measurement followed a download.

Completion announces placement in existing status regions. No general completion-focus change: audit did not isolate origin-specific intended focus and search intentionally avoids keyboard reopening; scope keeps completion navigation unchanged.
Search-origin cancel deliberately does not focus the text input, avoiding mobile keyboard reopening. Existing behavior preserved.

additionalFindings.rationale: Canceled queue focus and scroll callbacks capture owner generation and require current owner, same destination and no replacement ranking. Existing modal scope guard retained.

Before each synchronous preview render, captures actual current semantic control. Restores a visible enabled matching replacement or Close only if the original node was disconnected and Share Studio remains open. Does not capture an initiating control across an await.

Publishing/updating/revoking progress and save/revoke errors are owned by shareLinkState.message and reapplied by UI render; success/reset clears them. Existing owner token checks and write semantics remain unchanged.
